title: FloatValue
description: This mod will add float value like in CS2 to your swords
body:
### FloatValue
Adds a float value to all swords.
Each sword gets a unique random float when it first appears in a player's inventory.
Values are persistent and can be used in datapacks, server logic, or mods to affect gameplay. Also, different floats has different chances to appear.

![This is an example. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a13e9180b9ca49028d6d6a0d329cdacb836467a2.png)

This is an example of the final view.

You can use this mod with friends or try to trade the most rare weapons!
